subject: [hw] V32 start: n2shim_thread (threads/mutex/cond/sem/rwlock/sched/signal)
body:
V32 starting. Read PLAN, TASK, WORKER_RULES, FACTS, n2a32.h, n2elf.h, the board, V02/V03/V30 sources.

Plan: shim/n2shim_thread.c + shim/n2shim_thread.h + shim/test_v32. Guest pthread objects are 4 bytes (rwlock 40) so every object is a side-table entry keyed by guest address, created on first use under one global lock (zero-initialised objects work, incl. PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER); destroy unrefs and frees. Guest threads are host threads, each with its own struct n2a32_cpu on the shared n2a32_mem and a 1 MiB guest stack from n2a32_mem_alloc (stack pool on exit). pthread_t = table slot + 1 (0 never valid).

Tests: a real ARM .so (clang --target=armv7a-linux-androideabi -marm -march=armv8-a -mfloat-abi=soft -fPIC -shared -nostdlib) driven through V03 real loader + V02 real core + A32 classes: producer/consumer mutex+cond, 8 threads x 100000 increments on a zero-initialised mutex, sem ping-pong, pthread_once from 8 threads, rwlock readers/writers, pthread_exit/join return values, detached attr, a bad start address -> first-failure slot + stop_request propagation, plus host-direct calls with a fake cpu for invalid-id/error-return paths. ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2 and TSan -O1, same check count in all three builds.

Two questions posted separately.
